subject: Training on customer data opt-out confirmation
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: training-on-customer-data opt-out (Acme Health)

Hi Stephanie / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo this morning — it was helpful to see the latency/cost controls in action. As discussed on the call, Acme Health needs to confirm that any customer data sent to Redwood's hosted API will NOT be used to improve or train Redwood models. Our security team requires a written opt-out confirmation and a signed form for our procurement records.

Summary of our ask: 
- Redwood confirms Acme Health data will be excluded from model training and improvement pipelines.
- Please provide details on logging/retention (what is logged, how long logs are retained, and whether logs are accessible to non-RI personnel).
- Data residency: our production workloads are US-only — confirm storage/processing regions.

I attached the standard Opt-Out worksheet we use for push-through to legal. Can you confirm by EOD? If easier, a short signed PDF is fine.

Regards,
Alice Turner
Head of IT Security, Acme Health
alice.turner@acmehealth.com
Attachment: AcmeHealth-optout-worksheet.xlsx (stub)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: training-on-customer-data opt-out (Acme Health)

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear summary and for joining the call.

Short answer: we can absolutely opt Acme Health out of any model training or improvement pipelines. Confirmations below and next steps: 

1) Training opt-out: Redwood will mark the Acme Health account as "training_opt_out" in our serving/ingestion pipelines so data will not be copied or used for model training or evaluation. This applies to hosted API traffic and standard telemetry used for model improvement.

2) Logging & retention: we log request metadata (timestamp, model id, token counts, request id) and optional request/response bodies when customers enable request logging. By default, request/response bodies are not stored long-term. For Acme Health: 
- Request/response bodies: will NOT be stored for training; retention window will be 30 days for debugging logs unless you request a different policy.
- Access: logs are accessible only to named support/ops on your account and our SOC/infra on need-to-know basis; we can provide a list of authorized roles.

3) Data residency: hosted API requests routed to our US regions only (us-west-2/us-east-1). We will ensure routing policy pins to US region for your account.

4) Implementation: to apply the opt-out, we need a signed opt-out form (attached) or a signed DocuSign. Once signed we apply the flag within 24 hours.

Attached: Redwood-Training-Opt-Out-Form.pdf (stub)

Next steps: if this looks good I can have Marissa in Legal prepare the one-line contract addendum for procurement. Also happy to hop on a quick 15-min call to review.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen

Hi Ben / Alice — thanks for the signed form, and thanks Stephanie for the notes. 

Legal confirms: a signed opt-out form is sufficient to trigger the operational flag; we will also produce a one-line contract addendum if Procurement prefers an amendment on file. Either option is fine — the operational effect is the same.

Operational details we will provide in the onboarding packet (links below):
- Logs & retention: standard diagnostic logs retained 30 days. Customer-requested exports (for your audits) can be delivered via secure S3 link and will follow your retention policy on request.
- Access & controls: we will add Acme Health to our account-level allowlist so only authorized Redwood personnel can view debug logs; we will also enable tenant-scoped logging so logs are not accessible across accounts.
- Data residency: confirmed US-only processing and storage for your account.

I will:
- Apply the training_opt_out flag within 24 hours of this message (will reply when complete).
- Draft the optional one-line addendum and share a DocuSign link if you want it signed for your procurement records.
